sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel representing the Union of India as also the Delhi Police has stated that certain offences have been registered and criminal action is also being taken.
He further states on instructions that investigation in certain matters are at the verge of the completion and soon it is likely that the charge-sheet may be filed.
5. By the next date of listing, an affidavit on behalf of Delhi Police shall also be filed stating therein the action which might have been taken or which may be taken at their end in the matter.
